facts.value: When nb_args equals the unsigned -1 sentinel, counts all set bits in each Rvalue flags word and caches the sum. Lazily allocates a shared float buffer, default capacity 100, and panics instead of resizing if count exceeds capacity. facts.rationale: Separates bit count from produced arguments and documents shared scratch reuse rather than implying all counted inputs are initialized.
